challenges.finding: Publisher reports ADF violence at Mabalako (44 bodies recorded and an attempted arson of the Beni CTE), suspended activities at Bafwasende in Tshopo, insecurity on the Bolebole axis, and strikes in the four provinces over unpaid salaries. In Nord-Kivu, ADF killings at Aloya led to suspects and contacts being lost to follow-up. No intervention effect is established and no separate event dates are stated.

Contact follow-up covers six reporting provinces, with Sud-Ubangi reporting again; Nord-Ubangi prints zero contacts and an NA rate. Tshopo has the lowest rate (49.8%) while Bafwasende activities remain suspended for insecurity; the page does not say whether Bafwasende contacts are included in the Tshopo count, and no zero follow-up is inferred.
